in_sanskrit.name: Hamidur
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of the Sun
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hamidur एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Hamidur is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ham' which means God and 'Idur' which means Sun. The name Hamidur represents the God of the Sun, who is a symbol of power, strength, and protection.
